patches.summary: The v0.1 tree was written in this catalog because the Printing Press generator was not installed.
patches.reason: The customer-share ask is a New Central sync, brief, export, and doctor CLI with the same three env vars as central-mcp-server. A full 1,736-operation generation was not possible here. The raw api command is the escape hatch for paths that were not given their own subcommand.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passed. doctor with an empty config exits 10 and names CENTRAL_BASE_URL, CENTRAL_CLIENT_ID, and CENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET. A httptest sync fills SQLite and brief reports a down device, a critical alert, and firmware drift.
